questions.stem: Which of the following statements are true regarding the regulation of cholesterol synthesis? Insulin and thyroxine decrease HMG CoA reductase activity. Cortisol and glucagon decrease HMG CoA reductase activity. Statins inhibit HMG CoA reductase. Cholesterol increases HMG CoA reductase activity. Cholesterol represses transcription of HMG CoA reductase mRNA.
questions.stemHtml:
Which of the following statements are true regarding the regulation of cholesterol synthesis?

  1. Insulin and thyroxine decrease HMG CoA reductase activity.
  2. Cortisol and glucagon decrease HMG CoA reductase activity.
  3. Statins inhibit HMG CoA reductase.
  4. Cholesterol increases HMG CoA reductase activity.
  5. Cholesterol represses transcription of HMG CoA reductase mRNA.
